name: Thunderbrew
label: Quest
description: In Westfall, Grimbooze Thunderbrew is gathering what he needs for his next batch. Fresh hops keep his ale from turning thick as stew, and he shares kegs…
intro: In Westfall, Grimbooze Thunderbrew is gathering what he needs for his next batch. Fresh hops keep his ale from turning thick as stew, and he shares kegs with those who help.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hurry, my friend, move with haste
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
